payload.title: Tenant sites are eventually consistent with a TTL; no per-edit CloudFront purge
payload.description:
What: the shared stack serves with a TTL and versioned object keys; purging is rare and batched, not per edit. States the freshness promise in docs. Builds on PPY-409932.
Acceptance:
Scenario: An edit appears within the TTL with no invalidation
  Given a tenant edits a page
  When the TTL passes
  Then readers see the edit and no invalidation request was made
